correctness.rationale: Odd-degree conjugacy and reduced-norm parity excludes all nonzero anticommuting pairs. For quaternion division, trace invariance identifies the zero-Jordan pairs with orthogonal pairs in a three-dimensional nondegenerate space. Six off-diagonal and two diagonal-difference pure tensors give an explicit basis for the eight-dimensional kernel. Evaluating on the unit and pure quaternion vectors reconstructs each unique parameter. Split matrices are idempotent-generated and hence zero-Jordan-product determined. Exact checker output corroborates only finite examples.

value.rationale: The zero-Jordan-product vanishing condition is a natural preserver invariant. The result gives a full map classification for all target spaces and all quaternion division forms, an exact four-dimensional defect, a degree-two Brauer splitting detector, and a parity explanation at odd division degree. This goes beyond displaying one failure or enumerating a small field example and motivates higher-even-degree work.
